facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jack swung the axe. The beanstalk cracked. It started to fall. Jack chopped the beanstalk down.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack kept swinging the axe with all his might. The giant was screaming from high up on the beanstalk. Jack chopped the beanstalk down with one final swing. The enormous beanstalk cracked and began to fall. Mother pulled Jack to safety just in time. The beanstalk crashed to the ground with a thundering sound.
facts.Word cards: giant = 거인 / chased = 쫓았다 🆕 / fast = 빠르게 / terrified = 겁에 질린 🆕
